title: BEN — Bear Case Thesis
headings: The structural bear case in one sentence
Why the business may not be as good as it looks
1. The diversification narrative is statistically thin
2. Margin recovery is real but still market- and growth-opex dependent
3. Effective fee rate is a secular declining ratchet
4. Western Asset settlement is closed — but the franchise is not “fixed”
5. The decentralized SIM model is a contagion risk if a second SIM blows up
6. M&A has been the driver of growth — and the optionality is mostly used up
7. Putnam is a "home run" — but the math is benchmarked against low expectations
